notes: Pyre 1.2.3 — the reliability + quality release. Multi-device sync is now solid: an edit stamped 'in the past' by clock drift no longer goes invisible to your other devices, data hits the disk before the sync cursor moves (crash-safe) on both sides, the hub reports the honest outcome of every pushed item, and API-key sync is atomic. Security & data: your API key is no longer sent to a provider's NEW host after a URL change; a factory reset warns before losing an un-backupable image; backups now include in-progress character drafts, the BotBooru avatar original, image types (MIME), and an integrity checksum. Roleplay: long-term memory recap AND Live Sheet state refresh correctly after you edit a message or use Continue; [OOC] notes are no longer voiced as dialogue; a Stop or error right after swiping back to a good reply no longer deletes it; lorebooks got a full pass (entry order, constant-probability, macros, post-regex scan, per-entry character filter); the token breakdown counts every party persona. New: background generation (leave the app mid-reply and it keeps going), hand-written checkpoints, folders for Personas and Lorebooks, a per-chat provider, per-character bubble color and font, and a smarter AI Creator. Plus a cleaner UI (token banner gone, readable error banner, six tidied menus) and fixes for a runaway regex, a stuck checkpoint lock, and maxTokens overriding your global default.
